解析与编译#

Parse and compile

这里的关键函数是 mj_loadXML。它会调用内置的解析器和编译器，要么返回指向有效 mjModel 的指针，要么返回 NULL，此时用户应检查用户所提供字符串中的错误信息。模型及其引用的所有文件既可以从磁盘加载，也可以在提供 VFS 时从 VFS 加载。

The key function here is mj_loadXML. It invokes the built-in parser and compiler, and either returns a pointer to a valid mjModel, or NULL - in which case the user should check the error information in the user-provided string. The model and all files referenced in it can be loaded from disk or from a VFS when provided.

mj_loadXML#

mjModel* mj_loadXML(const char* filename, const mjVFS* vfs, char* error, int error_sz);

解析 MJCF 或 URDF 格式的 XML 文件并编译，返回底层模型（model）。

Parse XML file in MJCF or URDF format, compile it; return low-level model.

如果 vfs 不为 NULL，则先在 vfs 中查找文件，再从磁盘读取。

If vfs is not NULL, look up files in vfs before reading from disk.

如果 error 不为 NULL，则其大小必须为 error_sz。

If error is not NULL, it must have size error_sz.

Nullable: vfs, error

mj_parseXML#

mjSpec* mj_parseXML(const char* filename, const mjVFS* vfs, char* error, int error_sz);

从 XML 文件解析 spec。

Parse spec from XML file.

Nullable: vfs, error

mj_parseXMLString#

mjSpec* mj_parseXMLString(const char* xml, const mjVFS* vfs, char* error, int error_sz);

从 XML 字符串解析 spec。

Parse spec from XML string.

Nullable: vfs, error

mj_parse#

mjSpec* mj_parse(const char* filename, const char* content_type,
                 const mjVFS* vfs, char* error, int error_sz);

从文件解析 spec。

Parse spec from a file.

Nullable: vfs, error

mj_encode#

mjtSize mj_encode(const mjSpec* s, const mjModel* m, const char* filename,
                  const char* content_type, const mjVFS* vfs, char* error,
                  int error_sz);

将 mjSpec 或 mjModel 编码到文件。输出格式由文件扩展名（不区分大小写）或 content_type 决定。成功时返回写入的字节数，失败时返回 -1。

Encode mjSpec or mjModel to a file. The output format is determined by the file extension (case insensitive) or content_type. Returns the number of bytes written on success, -1 on failure.

有关详细文档、所支持的输出格式（.xml、.mjb、.txt、.mjz）以及自定义编码器插件（plugin），请参阅 模型编码与保存。

For detailed documentation, supported output formats (.xml, .mjb, .txt, .mjz), and custom encoder plugins, see Model Encoding & Saving.

Nullable: s, m, vfs, error

mj_compile#

mjModel* mj_compile(mjSpec* s, const mjVFS* vfs);

将 mjSpec 编译为 mjModel。spec 可以被多次编辑和编译，每次都会返回一个考虑了这些编辑的新 mjModel 实例。如果编译失败，mj_compile 返回 NULL；可以通过 mjs_getError 读取错误信息。

Compile mjSpec to mjModel. A spec can be edited and compiled multiple times, returning a new mjModel instance that takes the edits into account. If compilation fails, mj_compile returns NULL; the error can be read with mjs_getError.

编译会保持 spec 的书写形式不变，但有两个例外。其一，编译会补全 关键帧 （keyframe）：其向量会按模型的大小调整，并且关键帧会被补充到 nkey 个。其二，编译器属性 discardvisual 和 fusestatic 会在编译之前对 spec 应用 mjs_discardVisual 和 mjs_fuseStatic，这会改变 spec：指向被移除元素的指针将不再有效。失败的操作不会造成任何改变，但已成功的操作在后续操作或编译失败时仍会保持已应用的状态；此时错误信息会如实说明。

Compilation leaves the spec as it is written, with two exceptions. It completes keyframes: their vectors are sized for the model, and keyframes are added up to nkey. And the compiler attributes discardvisual and fusestatic apply mjs_discardVisual and mjs_fuseStatic to the spec before it is compiled, which changes it: pointers to the elements which they remove are no longer valid. An operation which fails changes nothing, but one which succeeded stays applied if a later one, or the compilation, fails; the error then says so.

mj_copyBack#

int mj_copyBack(mjSpec* s, const mjModel* m);

将由某个 mjSpec 编译得到的 mjModel 中被修改过的值复制回该 spec。之后可以在 spec 中读取这些修改，它们会随 spec 一同保存，并包含在之后由该 spec 编译出的模型中。当模型中的某个属性已不再是编译所赋予的值时，该属性的全部数值都会被复制；spec 中的其他内容保持原样，包括编译之后才写入其中的内容。位姿的位置与朝向，以及范围的上下界，都是各自独立的属性。成功时返回 1。如果模型不是由当前结构的 spec 编译而来，或者某个被修改的值无法在 spec 中表达，则返回 0；此时不会复制任何内容，错误信息可以通过 mjs_getError 读取。模型也可以被复制回由 mj_copySpec 创建的 spec 副本。

Copy to an mjSpec the values which were changed in the mjModel that was compiled from it. The changes can then be read in the spec, are saved with it, and are in the models which are compiled from it afterwards. An attribute is copied if the model no longer has what compilation gave it, all of its numbers; everything else in the spec is left as it is, including what was written there since it was compiled. The position and the orientation of a pose, and the bounds of a range, are separate attributes. Returns 1 on success. Returns 0 if the model was not compiled from the spec as it is structured now, or if a value was changed which the spec cannot express; nothing is copied then, and the error can be read with mjs_getError. A model can also be copied back to a copy of the spec made by mj_copySpec.

被复制的值包括 mjModel.opt、mjModel.vis 和 mjModel.stat，刚体（body）、关节（joint）、geom、site、相机、灯光、材质、接触对、等式约束（equality constraint）、肌腱（tendon）、执行器（actuator）和传感器（sensor）的实值参数，自定义数值和元组数据，关键帧，以及高度场的高程数据。每一项都按其编译前对应的写法写回：

The values which are copied are mjModel.opt, mjModel.vis and mjModel.stat, the real-valued parameters of bodies, joints, geoms, sites, cameras, lights, materials, contact pairs, equalities, tendons, actuators and sensors, custom numeric and tuple data, keyframes and the elevation data of height fields. Each is written as what compiles to it:

  • 位姿写在该元素所处的 坐标系 （frame）中。未被修改的朝向保持原有写法，例如欧拉角；被修改过的朝向则写成四元数（quaternion）。当编译会根据朝向对位置做偏移时，例如网格未以原点为中心的网格 geom，以及与其自由关节 对齐 的刚体，新的朝向也会同时写入位置。如果 mjModel.qpos0 被修改过，则带自由关节的刚体的参考位姿取自 mjModel.qpos0。

    A pose is written in the frame which the element is in. An orientation which was not changed stays as it was written, for example as Euler angles, and one which was changed is written as a quaternion. Where compilation offsets the position by the orientation, for a mesh geom whose mesh is not centered at its origin and a body which is aligned with its free joint, a new orientation also writes the position. The reference pose of a body with a free joint is taken from mjModel.qpos0 if that was changed.

  • 角度以 spec 的 单位 写入。

    Angles are written in the unit of the spec.

  • 以 fromto 写出的，或通过将 geom 拟合到网格（mesh）而计算得到的 geom 或 site 的尺寸和位姿，会被写在其原来的位置。胶囊体或圆柱体的新半径不会改变 fromto。

    The size and pose of a geom or site which were written as fromto, or computed by fitting a geom to a mesh, are written in its place. A new radius of a capsule or cylinder leaves fromto as it is.

  • 被修改过的质量或惯性（inertia）会使该刚体获得显式的 inertial，此后不再根据其 geom 推断；如果只修改了质量，已有 inertial 的刚体会保持其原有写法。其他刚体的惯性仍然跟随其 geom，包括被复制过来的尺寸或位姿。

    A mass or inertia which was changed gives the body an explicit inertial, which is then no longer inferred from its geoms; a body which has one keeps it as it was written if only the mass was changed. The inertia of the other bodies still follows their geoms, including a size or pose which was copied.

  • limited 属性为 "auto" 的范围会保持其在模型中的限位（limit）状态：如果按新范围推断会得到不同的结果，则会设置该属性。

    A range whose limited attribute is “auto” keeps the limited state which it has in the model: the attribute is set if the new range would be inferred otherwise.

  • 使用 springdamper 的关节的刚度（stiffness）或阻尼（damping），以及通过 inheritrange 继承而来的控制或激活范围，会被写在其原来的位置。

    A stiffness or damping of a joint with springdamper, and a control or activation range which was inherited with inheritrange, are written in its place.

  • 从文件读取的高度场的高程数据，会被写入以取代该文件。

    Elevation data of a height field which was read from a file is written in place of the file.

  • 两个刚体之间的 weld，若由非零的 mjModel.eq_data[11] 标记，则其相对位姿按计算值写入，并带有零四元数。

    The relative pose of a weld between bodies which is marked by a nonzero mjModel.eq_data[11] is written as computed, with a zero quaternion.

下列修改无法在 spec 中表达，会导致错误：当 inertiafromgeom 为 "true" 或设置了 settotalmass 时，刚体的质量或惯性；与其自由关节 对齐 的刚体的惯性坐标系；世界刚体（world body）的位姿；自由关节的锚点或轴，以及球关节的轴；网格或高度场 geom 以及网格 site 的尺寸，以及网格的坐标系；带有传感器尺寸的相机的视场角，以及不带传感器尺寸的相机的内参；以及某个执行器各输入的不同控制范围。下一次编译不会保留的修改同样会导致错误：球关节或自由关节各自由度（degree of freedom）之间不同的阻尼、电枢惯量（armature）、摩擦损耗（frictionloss）或其求解器参数；最低值和最高值不是 0 和 1 的高度场的高程数据；刚体之间的 connect 在其第二个刚体中的锚点，或已标记的 weld 的相对位姿，只要不是 mj_setConst 所计算出的值。

The following changes cannot be expressed in the spec and are errors: the mass or inertia of a body when inertiafromgeom is “true” or settotalmass is set; the inertial frame of a body which is aligned with its free joint; the pose of the world body; the anchor or axis of a free joint and the axis of a ball joint; the size of a mesh or height field geom or of a mesh site, and the frame of a mesh; the field of view of a camera which has a sensor size, and the intrinsics of one which has none; and different control ranges for the inputs of an actuator which has one. So are changes which the next compilation would not keep: damping, armature, friction loss or their solver parameters which differ between the degrees of freedom of a ball or free joint; elevation data of a height field whose lowest and highest values are not 0 and 1; and the anchor of a connect between bodies in its second body, or the relative pose of a marked weld, other than the one which mj_setConst computes.

mj_recompile#

int mj_recompile(mjSpec* s, const mjVFS* vfs, mjModel* m, mjData* d);

将 spec 重新编译为模型，并保留状态。与 mj_compile 类似，该函数将 mjSpec 编译为 mjModel，但有两点不同。第一，它不会返回全新的模型，而是原地重新分配已有的 mjModel 和 mjData 实例。第二，它会保留所提供的 mjData 实例中给出的 积分状态，同时兼顾新增或移除的自由度。这样用户就可以在以编程方式编辑模型的同时，继续使用相同的 model 和 data 结构体指针进行仿真。

Recompile spec to model, preserving the state. Like mj_compile, this function compiles an mjSpec to an mjModel, with two differences. First, rather than returning an entirely new model, it will reallocate existing mjModel and mjData instances in-place. Second, it will preserve the integration state, as given in the provided mjData instance, while accounting for newly added or removed degrees of freedom. This allows the user to continue simulation with the same model and data struct pointers while editing the model programmatically.

如果编译成功，mj_recompile 返回 0。如果失败，给定的 mjModel 和 mjData 实例将被删除；与 mj_compile 一样，编译错误可以通过 mjs_getError 读取。

mj_recompile returns 0 if compilation succeed. In the case of failure, the given mjModel and mjData instances will be deleted; as in mj_compile, the compilation error can be read with mjs_getError.

mj_loadTexture#

int mj_loadTexture(const mjModel* m, int id, mjtByte** data, int* width, int* height,
                   int* colorspace, char* error, int error_sz);

将纹理 id 解码为原始字节，其内容与编译时存入 tex_data 的完全一致，通道数为 tex_nchannel；内嵌纹理从模型中复制。缓冲区由 mju_malloc 分配，并由调用者释放；colorspace 接收解析得到的颜色空间（mjtColorSpace）。

Decode texture id to raw bytes, exactly what compilation would store in tex_data, with tex_nchannel channels; embedded textures are copied from the model. The buffer is allocated with mju_malloc and freed by the caller; colorspace receives the resolved colorspace (mjtColorSpace).

成功时返回 0。

Return 0 on success.

Nullable: width, height, colorspace, error

mj_embedAssets#

mjModel* mj_embedAssets(const mjModel* m, char* error, int error_sz);

返回 m 的副本，其中每个按引用方式引用的资源都已加载到副本中，与编译时存储的形式一致。

Copy of m with every by-reference asset loaded into it, as compilation would have stored it.

如果有文件无法解析，则返回 NULL 并给出 error。含有按引用方式引用的资源的模型，其自包含（hermetic）MJB 文件的生成方式为：先调用 mj_embedAssets，再调用 mj_saveModel，最后调用 mj_deleteModel。

Return NULL with error on a file that does not resolve. A hermetic MJB file of a model with by-reference assets is mj_embedAssets, then mj_saveModel, then mj_deleteModel.

Nullable: error

mj_saveLastXML#

int mj_saveLastXML(const char* filename, const mjModel* m, char* error, int error_sz);

用通过 mj_loadXML 创建的底层模型中的信息更新 XML 数据结构，并保存为 MJCF。如果 error 不为 NULL，则其大小必须为 error_sz。

Update XML data structures with info from low-level model created with mj_loadXML, save as MJCF. If error is not NULL, it must have size error_sz.

请注意，该函数只能保存通过 mj_loadXML （即旧版加载机制）加载的模型。关于新旧两种模型加载与保存机制的区别，请参阅 模型编辑 一章。

Note that this function only saves models that have been loaded with mj_loadXML, the legacy loading mechanism. See the model editing chapter to understand the difference between the old and new model loading and saving mechanisms.

mj_freeLastXML#

void mj_freeLastXML(void);

如果已加载，则释放最近一次的 XML 模型。每次加载时都会在内部调用。

Free last XML model if loaded. Called internally at each load.

mj_saveXMLString#

int mj_saveXMLString(const mjSpec* s, char* xml, int xml_sz, char* error, int error_sz);

将 spec 保存为 XML 字符串，成功时返回 0，失败时返回 -1。如果输出缓冲区的长度太小，则返回所需的大小。关于保存的内容，请参阅 mj_saveXML。

Save spec to XML string, return 0 on success, -1 on failure. If the length of the output buffer is too small, returns the required size. See mj_saveXML for what is saved.

mj_saveXML#

int mj_saveXML(const mjSpec* s, const char* filename, char* error, int error_sz);

将 spec 保存为 XML 文件，成功时返回 0，否则返回 -1。spec 的编译器属性 savecompiled 和 savecanonical 决定了模型是按编译后的形式还是按 spec 中的书写形式保存，以及使用何种记法；请参阅 模型编码与保存。保存编译后的值要求 spec 事先已被编译，并且在结构性编辑（添加、删除或附加元素）之后再次编译。

Save spec to XML file, return 0 on success, -1 otherwise. The compiler attributes savecompiled and savecanonical of the spec say whether the model is saved as it was compiled or as it is written in the spec, and in which notation; see Model Encoding & Saving. Saving the compiled values requires that the spec first be compiled, and compiled again after it is structurally edited (elements added, deleted or attached).

mju_getXMLDependencies#

void mju_getXMLDependencies(const char* filename, mjStringVec* dependencies);

给定 MJCF 文件名，用其所依赖的所有其他资源文件的列表填充 dependencies。

Given MJCF filename, fills dependencies with a list of all other asset files it depends on.

搜索是递归的，列表中包含该文件名本身。

The search is recursive, and the list includes the filename itself.

主仿真#

Main simulation

这些是仿真器的主要入口点。大多数用户只需调用 mj_step，它会完成全部计算，并将仿真状态推进一个时间步长（time step）。控制（control）和外加力必须预先设置（在 mjData.{ctrl, qfrc_applied, xfrc_applied} 中），或者安装一个控制回调 mjcb_control，它会在需要控制和外加力之前被调用。另外，也可以使用 mj_step1 和 mj_step2，它们将仿真流水线拆分为在需要控制之前和之后执行的两部分计算；这样就可以设置依赖于 mj_step1 结果的控制。不过请注意，RK4 求解器不能配合 mj_step1/2 使用。更详细的说明请参阅 仿真流水线。

These are the main entry points to the simulator. Most users will only need to call mj_step, which computes everything and advanced the simulation state by one time step. Controls and applied forces must either be set in advance (in mjData.{ctrl, qfrc_applied, xfrc_applied}), or a control callback mjcb_control must be installed which will be called just before the controls and applied forces are needed. Alternatively, one can use mj_step1 and mj_step2 which break down the simulation pipeline into computations that are executed before and after the controls are needed; in this way one can set controls that depend on the results from mj_step1. Keep in mind though that the RK4 solver does not work with mj_step1/2. See Simulation pipeline for a more detailed description.

mj_forward 执行与 mj_step 相同的计算，但不进行积分。它在加载或重置模型之后（使整个 mjData 处于有效状态）很有用，也适用于涉及采样或有限差分近似的乱序计算。

mj_forward performs the same computations as mj_step but without the integration. It is useful after loading or resetting a model (to put the entire mjData in a valid state), and also for out-of-order computations that involve sampling or finite-difference approximations.

mj_inverse 运行逆动力学（inverse dynamics），并将输出写入 mjData.qfrc_inverse。请注意，调用该函数之前必须设置 mjData.qacc。给定状态（qpos、qvel、act），mj_forward 实现从力到加速度的映射，而 mj_inverse 实现从加速度到力的映射。从数学上讲，这两个函数互为逆运算，但在数值上并不总是如此，因为正动力学（forward dynamics）依赖于约束优化算法，而该算法通常会提前终止。正动力学和逆动力学结果之间的差异可以用函数 mj_compareFwdInv 计算，它可被视为另一种求解器（solver）精度检查（同时也是一种通用的合理性检查）。

mj_inverse runs the inverse dynamics, and writes its output in mjData.qfrc_inverse. Note that mjData.qacc must be set before calling this function. Given the state (qpos, qvel, act), mj_forward maps from force to acceleration, while mj_inverse maps from acceleration to force. Mathematically these functions are inverse of each other, but numerically this may not always be the case because the forward dynamics rely on a constraint optimization algorithm which is usually terminated early. The difference between the results of forward and inverse dynamics can be computed with the function mj_compareFwdInv, which can be thought of as another solver accuracy check (as well as a general sanity check).

mj_forward 和 mj_inverse 的 skip 版本很有用，例如当 qpos 未变而 qvel 改变时（通常出现在有限差分的场景中）。此时没有必要重复那些只依赖于 qpos 的计算。以 skipstage = mjSTAGE_POS 调用动力学函数即可实现这种节省。

The skip version of mj_forward and mj_inverse are useful for example when qpos was unchanged but qvel was changed (usually in the context of finite differencing). Then there is no point repeating the computations that only depend on qpos. Calling the dynamics with skipstage = mjSTAGE_POS will achieve these savings.

推进仿真，使用控制回调获取外力和控制。

辅助函数#

Support

这些是需要访问 mjModel 和 mjData 的辅助函数，与不需要此类访问的工具函数不同。辅助函数在仿真器内部被调用，其中一些也可用于自定义计算，下文对它们作了更详细的说明。

These are support functions that need access to mjModel and mjData, unlike the utility functions which do not need such access. Support functions are called within the simulator but some of them can also be useful for custom computations, and are documented in more detail below.

mj_stateSize#

int mj_stateSize(const mjModel* m, int sig);

返回给定状态签名所需的 mjtNum⁠个数。整数 sig 的各个比特对应于 mjtState 的元素字段。

Returns the number of mjtNum⁠s required for a given state signature. The bits of the integer sig correspond to element fields of mjtState.

mj_getState#

void mj_getState(const mjModel* m, const mjData* d, mjtNum* state, int sig);

将由 sig 指定的各状态分量从 d 拼接复制到 state。整数 sig 的各个比特对应于 mjtState 的元素字段。如果 sig 无效，则以 mju_error 报错。

Copy concatenated state components specified by sig from d into state. The bits of the integer sig correspond to element fields of mjtState. Fails with mju_error if sig is invalid.

mj_extractState#

void mj_extractState(const mjModel* m, const mjtNum* src, int srcsig,
                     mjtNum* dst, int dstsig);

从先前通过 mj_getState 获得的、分量由 srcsig 指定的状态 src 中，提取由 dstsig 指定的分量子集到 dst。如果 dstsig 中置位的比特不是 srcsig 中置位比特的子集，则以 mju_error 报错。

Extract into dst the subset of components specified by dstsig from a state src previously obtained via mj_getState with components specified by srcsig. Fails with mju_error if the bits set in dstsig is not a subset of the bits set in srcsig.

mj_setState#

void mj_setState(const mjModel* m, mjData* d, const mjtNum* state, int sig);

将由 sig 指定的各状态分量从 state 拼接复制到 d。整数 sig 的各个比特对应于 mjtState 的元素字段。如果 sig 无效，则以 mju_error 报错。

Copy concatenated state components specified by sig from state into d. The bits of the integer sig correspond to element fields of mjtState. Fails with mju_error if sig is invalid.

mj_copyState#

void mj_copyState(const mjModel* m, const mjData* src, mjData* dst, int sig);

将状态从 src 复制到 dst。

Copy state from src to dst.

mj_readCtrl#

const mjtNum* mj_readCtrl(const mjModel* m, const mjData* d, int id, mjtNum time,
                          mjtNum* result, int interp);

读取某个执行器在给定时刻的控制值，并考虑延迟。如果不存在历史缓冲区，则返回指向该执行器在 mjData.ctrl 中对应片段的指针。如果存在历史缓冲区（nsample > 0），则从延迟缓冲区中读取 time - actuator_delay[id] 时刻的值。请注意，减去延迟会改变 time 参数的语义：从“数值被推入延迟缓冲区的时刻”变为“数值从延迟缓冲区中取出的时刻”。详情请参阅 延迟。

Read the control value for an actuator at a given time, taking delays into account. If no history buffer exists, return a pointer to the actuator’s slice of mjData.ctrl. If a history buffer exists (nsample > 0), read from the delay buffer at time - actuator_delay[id]. Note that the subtraction of the delay changes the semantic of the time argument from “time at which values were pushed into the delay buffer” to “time at which values come out of the delay buffer”. See Delays for details.

返回值语义：

Return value semantics:

  • 如果不存在历史缓冲区（nsample = 0），则返回指向该执行器在 mjData.ctrl 中对应片段的指针。

    If no history buffer exists (nsample = 0), returns a pointer to the actuator’s slice of mjData.ctrl.

  • 如果存在历史缓冲区（nsample > 0），并且所请求的时刻与某个已存储的采样一致（对于 interp = 0 总是如此），则返回指向历史缓冲区中该数据的指针。

    If a history buffer exists (nsample > 0) and the requested time matches a stored sample (always true for interp = 0), returns a pointer to the data in the history buffer.

  • 如果需要插值（interp = 1 or 2），则返回 NULL，并将插值结果写入 result （其大小必须为 actuator_ctrlnum[id]）。

    If interpolation is required (interp = 1 or 2), returns NULL and writes the interpolated result to result (must be of size actuator_ctrlnum[id]).

插值：

Interpolation:

  • interp = 0：零阶保持（分段常数）

    interp = 0: Zero-order hold (piecewise constant)

  • interp = 1：分段线性

    interp = 1: Piecewise Linear

  • interp = 2：三次样条（Catmull-Rom）

    interp = 2: Cubic Spline (Catmull-Rom)

  • interp = -1：使用该执行器的 interp 值。

    interp = -1: Use the actuator’s interp value.

在缓冲区范围之外使用常数外推。

Constant extrapolation is used outside of buffer bounds.

mj_readSensor#

const mjtNum* mj_readSensor(const mjModel* m, const mjData* d, int id, mjtNum time,
                            mjtNum* result, int interp);

读取某个传感器在给定时刻的值，并考虑延迟。如果不存在历史缓冲区，则返回指向该传感器在 mjData.sensordata 中对应片段的指针。如果存在历史缓冲区（nsample > 0），则从历史缓冲区中读取 time - sensor_delay[id] 时刻的值。请注意，减去延迟会改变 time 参数的语义：从“数值被推入延迟缓冲区的时刻”变为“数值从延迟缓冲区中取出的时刻”。详情请参阅 延迟。

Read a sensor value at a given time, taking delays into account. If no history buffer exists, return a pointer to the sensor’s slice of mjData.sensordata. If a history buffer exists (nsample > 0), read from the history buffer at time - sensor_delay[id]. Note that the subtraction of the delay changes the semantic of the time argument from “time at which values were pushed into the delay buffer” to “time at which values come out of the delay buffer”. See Delays for details.

返回值语义：

Return value semantics:

  • 如果不存在历史缓冲区（nsample = 0），则返回指向该传感器在 mjData.sensordata 中对应片段的指针。

    If no history buffer exists (nsample = 0), returns a pointer to the sensor’s slice of mjData.sensordata.

  • 如果存在历史缓冲区（nsample > 0），并且所请求的时刻与某个已存储的采样一致（对于 interp = 0 总是如此），则返回指向历史缓冲区中该数据的指针。

    If a history buffer exists (nsample > 0) and the requested time matches a stored sample (always true for interp = 0), returns a pointer to the data in the history buffer.

  • 如果需要插值（interp = 1 or 2），则返回 NULL，并将插值结果写入 result （其大小必须为 dim）。

    If interpolation is required (interp = 1 or 2), returns NULL and writes the interpolated result to result (must be of size dim).

插值：

Interpolation:

  • interp = 0：零阶保持（分段常数）

    interp = 0: Zero-order hold (piecewise constant)

  • interp = 1：分段线性

    interp = 1: Piecewise Linear

  • interp = 2：三次样条（Catmull-Rom）

    interp = 2: Cubic Spline (Catmull-Rom)

  • interp = -1：使用 interp 中的值

    interp = -1: Use the value in interp

在缓冲区范围之外使用常数外推。

Constant extrapolation is used outside of buffer bounds.

用法：

Usage:
// read sensor 0 of data size `dim` at time t
mjtNum result[dim];
const mjtNum* ptr = mj_readSensor(m, d, 0, t, result, /* interp = */ 1);
const mjtNum* data = ptr ? ptr : result;

mj_initCtrlHistory#

void mj_initCtrlHistory(const mjModel* m, mjData* d, int id,
                        const mjtNum* times, const mjtNum* values);

用自定义值初始化某个执行器的历史缓冲区。times 数组指定每个采样的时间戳（长度必须为 nsample），values 指定控制值（大小必须为 nsample * actuator_ctrlnum[id]）。如果 times 为 NULL，则使用缓冲区中已有的时间戳，仅更新数值。详情请参阅 延迟。

Initialize the history buffer for an actuator with custom values. The times array specifies the timestamps for each sample (must be length nsample), and values specifies the control values (must be of size nsample * actuator_ctrlnum[id]). If times is NULL, the existing timestamps in the buffer are used, and only the values are updated. See Delays for details.

mj_initSensorHistory#

void mj_initSensorHistory(const mjModel* m, mjData* d, int id,
                          const mjtNum* times, const mjtNum* values, mjtNum phase);

用自定义值初始化某个传感器的历史缓冲区。times 数组指定每个采样的时间戳（长度必须为 nsample），values 指定传感器值（大小必须为 nsample * dim）。如果 times 为 NULL，则使用缓冲区中已有的时间戳。 phase 参数设置用户槽位，该槽位存储间隔型传感器上一次的计算时间。详情请参阅 延迟。

Initialize the history buffer for a sensor with custom values. The times array specifies the timestamps for each sample (must be length nsample), and values specifies the sensor values (must be of size nsample * dim). If times is NULL, the existing timestamps in the buffer are used. The phase argument sets the user slot, which stores the last computation time for interval sensors. See Delays for details.

mj_setKeyframe#

void mj_setKeyframe(mjModel* m, const mjData* d, int k);

将当前状态复制到模型的第 k 个关键帧。

Copy current state to the k-th model keyframe.

mj_addContact#

int mj_addContact(const mjModel* m, mjData* d, const mjContact* con);

向 d->contact 列表添加接触（contact）；成功时返回 0；缓冲区已满时返回 1。

Add contact to d->contact list; return 0 if success; 1 if buffer full.

mj_isPyramidal#

int mj_isPyramidal(const mjModel* m);

判断摩擦锥的类型。

Determine type of friction cone.

mj_isSparse#

int mj_isSparse(const mjModel* m);

判断约束雅可比（Jacobian）的类型。

Determine type of constraint Jacobian.

mj_isDual#

int mj_isDual(const mjModel* m);

判断求解器的类型（PGS 为对偶型，CG 和 Newton 为原始型）。

Determine type of solver (PGS is dual, CG and Newton are primal).

mj_mulJacVec#

void mj_mulJacVec(const mjModel* m, const mjData* d, mjtNum* res, const mjtNum* vec);

该函数将约束雅可比 mjData.efc_J 乘以一个向量。请注意，雅可比既可以是稠密的，也可以是稀疏的；该函数能够识别这一设置。乘以 J 会将速度从关节空间映射到约束空间。

This function multiplies the constraint Jacobian mjData.efc_J by a vector. Note that the Jacobian can be either dense or sparse; the function is aware of this setting. Multiplication by J maps velocities from joint space to constraint space.

mj_mulJacTVec#

void mj_mulJacTVec(const mjModel* m, const mjData* d, mjtNum* res, const mjtNum* vec);

与 mj_mulJacVec 相同，但乘以雅可比的转置。这会将力从约束空间映射到关节空间。

Same as mj_mulJacVec but multiplies by the transpose of the Jacobian. This maps forces from constraint space to joint space.

mj_jac#

void mj_jac(const mjModel* m, const mjData* d, mjtNum* jacp, mjtNum* jacr,
            const mjtNum point[3], int body);

该函数计算末端执行器的运动学雅可比，描述自由度与给定点之间的局部线性关系。给定一个由整数 id（body）指定的刚体，以及世界坐标系中的一个三维点（point），该点被视为固连在该刚体上，则雅可比包含平动（jacp）和转动（jacr）两个分量。对任一指针传入 NULL 将跳过对应部分的计算。每个分量都是 3 x nv 的矩阵。该矩阵的每一行是指定点相应坐标对各自由度的梯度。计算雅可比所采用的坐标系以刚体质心为中心，但与世界坐标系对齐。要使雅可比的计算与当前广义坐标（generalized coordinates） mjData.qpos 保持一致，所需的最少 流水线阶段 是先 mj_kinematics，再 mj_comPos。

This function computes an end-effector kinematic Jacobian, describing the local linear relationship between the degrees-of-freedom and a given point. Given a body specified by its integer id (body) and a 3D point in the world frame (point) treated as attached to the body, the Jacobian has both translational (jacp) and rotational (jacr) components. Passing NULL for either pointer will skip that part of the computation. Each component is a 3-by-nv matrix. Each row of this matrix is the gradient of the corresponding coordinate of the specified point with respect to the degrees-of-freedom. The frame with respect to which the Jacobian is computed is centered at the body center-of-mass but aligned with the world frame. The minimal pipeline stages required for Jacobian computations to be consistent with the current generalized positions mjData.qpos are mj_kinematics followed by mj_comPos.

Nullable: jacp, jacr

mj_jacBody#

void mj_jacBody(const mjModel* m, const mjData* d, mjtNum* jacp, mjtNum* jacr, int body);

该函数及其余各雅可比函数变体都在内部调用 mj_jac，分别取刚体、geom 或 site 的中心。它们只是快捷方式；直接调用 mj_jac 也能达到同样的效果。

This and the remaining variants of the Jacobian function call mj_jac internally, with the center of the body, geom or site. They are just shortcuts; the same can be achieved by calling mj_jac directly.

Nullable: jacp, jacr

mj_jacBodyCom#

void mj_jacBodyCom(const mjModel* m, const mjData* d, mjtNum* jacp, mjtNum* jacr, int body);

计算刚体质心的末端执行器雅可比。

Compute body center-of-mass end-effector Jacobian.

Nullable: jacp, jacr

mj_jacSubtreeCom#

void mj_jacSubtreeCom(const mjModel* m, mjData* d, mjtNum* jacp, int body);

计算子树质心的末端执行器雅可比。

Compute subtree center-of-mass end-effector Jacobian.

mj_jacGeom#

void mj_jacGeom(const mjModel* m, const mjData* d, mjtNum* jacp, mjtNum* jacr, int geom);

计算 geom 的末端执行器雅可比。

Compute geom end-effector Jacobian.

Nullable: jacp, jacr

mj_jacSite#

void mj_jacSite(const mjModel* m, const mjData* d, mjtNum* jacp, mjtNum* jacr, int site);

计算 site 的末端执行器雅可比。

Compute site end-effector Jacobian.

Nullable: jacp, jacr

mj_jacPointAxis#

void mj_jacPointAxis(const mjModel* m, mjData* d, mjtNum* jacPoint, mjtNum* jacAxis,
                     const mjtNum point[3], const mjtNum axis[3], int body);

计算点的平动末端执行器雅可比，以及轴的转动雅可比。

Compute translation end-effector Jacobian of point, and rotation Jacobian of axis.

Nullable: jacPoint, jacAxis

mj_jacDot#

void mj_jacDot(const mjModel* m, const mjData* d, mjtNum* jacp, mjtNum* jacr,
               const mjtNum point[3], int body);

该函数计算由 mj_jac 算得的末端执行器运动学雅可比的时间导数。要使计算与当前广义位置和速度 mjData.{qpos, qvel} 保持一致，所需的最少 流水线阶段 依次是 mj_kinematics、mj_comPos、mj_comVel。

This function computes the time-derivative of an end-effector kinematic Jacobian computed by mj_jac. The minimal pipeline stages required for computation to be consistent with the current generalized positions and velocities mjData.{qpos, qvel} are mj_kinematics, mj_comPos, mj_comVel (in that order).

Nullable: jacp, jacr

mj_angmomMat#

void mj_angmomMat(const mjModel* m, mjData* d, mjtNum* mat, int body);

该函数计算 3 x nv 的角动量矩阵 \(H(q)\)，给出从广义速度到子树角动量的线性映射。更准确地说，如果 \(h\) 是 mjData.subtree_angmom 中刚体索引 body 的子树角动量（由 subtreeangmom 传感器报告），\(\dot q\) 是广义速度 mjData.qvel，则 \(h = H \dot q\)。

This function computes the 3 x nv angular momentum matrix \(H(q)\), providing the linear mapping from generalized velocities to subtree angular momentum. More precisely if \(h\) is the subtree angular momentum of body index body in mjData.subtree_angmom (reported by the subtreeangmom sensor) and \(\dot q\) is the generalized velocity mjData.qvel, then \(h = H \dot q\).

mj_applyFT#

void mj_applyFT(const mjModel* m, mjData* d, const mjtNum force[3], const mjtNum torque[3],
                const mjtNum point[3], int body, mjtNum* qfrc_target);

该函数可用于对刚体（body）上的某一点施加笛卡尔力和力矩，并将结果累加到所有外加力的向量 mjData.qfrc_applied 中。请注意，该函数需要传入指向此向量的指针，因为有时我们希望把结果加到另一个向量上。

This function can be used to apply a Cartesian force and torque to a point on a body, and add the result to the vector mjData.qfrc_applied of all applied forces. Note that the function requires a pointer to this vector, because sometimes we want to add the result to a different vector.

mj_objectVelocity#

void mj_objectVelocity(const mjModel* m, const mjData* d,
                       int objtype, int objid, mjtNum res[6], int flg_local);

在以物体为中心的坐标系（frame）中计算物体的 6D 速度（旋转:线性），朝向可选世界或局部坐标系。

Compute object 6D velocity (rot:lin) in object-centered frame, world/local orientation.

mj_objectAcceleration#

void mj_objectAcceleration(const mjModel* m, const mjData* d,
                           int objtype, int objid, mjtNum res[6], int flg_local);

在以物体为中心的坐标系中计算物体的 6D 加速度（旋转:线性），朝向可选世界或局部坐标系。如果模型中不存在加速度或力传感器（sensor），则必须手动调用 mj_rnePostConstraint 来计算 mjData.cacc，即刚体的总加速度，其中包含约束求解器（constraint solver）的贡献。

Compute object 6D acceleration (rot:lin) in object-centered frame, world/local orientation. If acceleration or force sensors are not present in the model, mj_rnePostConstraint must be manually called in order to calculate mjData.cacc – the total body acceleration, including contributions from the constraint solver.

mj_geomDistance#

mjtNum mj_geomDistance(const mjModel* m, mjData* d, int geom1, int geom2, mjtNum distmax,
                       mjtNum fromto[6]);

返回两个 geom 之间的最小有符号距离，并可选地返回从 geom1 到 geom2 的线段。返回的距离以 distmax 为上界。
如果没有找到距离小于 distmax 的碰撞，函数将返回 distmax，并且若提供了 fromto，则将其设为 (0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)。

Returns the smallest signed distance between two geoms and optionally the segment from geom1 to geom2. Returned distances are bounded from above by distmax.
If no collision of distance smaller than distmax is found, the function will return distmax and fromto, if given, will be set to (0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0).

可为 NULL： fromto

Nullable: fromto

在 nativeccd 下行为不同（正确）

different (correct) behavior under nativeccd

如 碰撞检测 中所述，使用 旧版 CCD 流水线 时距离不准确，因此不建议使用。

As explained in Collision Detection, distances are inaccurate when using the legacy CCD pipeline, and its use is discouraged.

mj_insideSite#

int mj_insideSite(const mjModel* m, const mjData* d, int siteid, const mjtNum point[3]);

如果点位于 site 内部（对于网格（mesh）则指凸包内部），返回 1，否则返回 0。

Return 1 if point is inside a site (convex hull for meshes), 0 otherwise.

mj_contactForce#

void mj_contactForce(const mjModel* m, const mjData* d, int id, mjtNum result[6]);

给定接触（contact）id，在接触坐标系中提取 6D 力:力矩。

Extract 6D force:torque given contact id, in the contact frame.

mj_differentiatePos#

void mj_differentiatePos(const mjModel* m, mjtNum* qvel, mjtNum dt,
                         const mjtNum* qpos1, const mjtNum* qpos2);

该函数对两个 qpos 格式的向量做减法（并将结果除以 dt），同时遵守四元数（quaternion）的性质。请记住，单位四元数表示空间朝向，它们是 4D 空间中单位球面上的点。该球面的切空间是由旋转速度构成的 3D 平面。因此，当我们以正确的方式对两个四元数做减法时，结果是一个 3D 向量，而不是 4D 向量。所以输出 qvel 的维度为 nv，而输入的维度为 nq。

This function subtracts two vectors in the format of qpos (and divides the result by dt), while respecting the properties of quaternions. Recall that unit quaternions represent spatial orientations. They are points on the unit sphere in 4D. The tangent to that sphere is a 3D plane of rotational velocities. Thus when we subtract two quaternions in the right way, the result is a 3D vector and not a 4D vector. Thus the output qvel has dimensionality nv while the inputs have dimensionality nq.

mj_integratePos#

void mj_integratePos(const mjModel* m, mjtNum* qpos, const mjtNum* qvel, mjtNum dt);

这是 mj_differentiatePos 的逆操作。它将一个 qvel 格式的向量（乘以 dt 缩放）加到一个 qpos 格式的向量上。

This is the opposite of mj_differentiatePos. It adds a vector in the format of qvel (scaled by dt) to a vector in the format of qpos.

mj_normalizeQuat#

void mj_normalizeQuat(const mjModel* m, mjtNum* qpos);

对 qpos 类型向量中的所有四元数做归一化。

Normalize all quaternions in qpos-type vector.

void mj_local2Global(mjData* d, mjtNum xpos[3], mjtNum xmat[9], const mjtNum pos[3],

Map from body local to global Cartesian coordinates, sameframe takes values from mjtSameFrame.

Sum all body masses.

Scale body masses and inertias to achieve specified total mass.

Load a dynamic library. The dynamic library is assumed to register one or more plugins.

mj_loadAllPluginLibraries#

扫描一个目录并加载其中所有的动态库。假定指定目录中的动态库会注册一个或多个插件。另外，如果指定了回调函数，则对于遇到的每个注册了插件的动态库都会调用该回调。加载失败的库会被跳过，并给出警告。

计算执行器传动（transmission）的长度和力矩。

void mj_crb(const mjModel* m, mjData* d);

运行复合刚体惯性算法（CRB）。

Run composite rigid body inertia algorithm (CRB).

mj_makeM#

void mj_makeM(const mjModel* m, mjData* d);

使用 mj_crb 计算复合刚体惯性，并加入由 肌腱电枢惯量 产生的项。关节空间的惯性矩阵同时存储在 mjData.qM 和 mjData.M 中。这两个数组以不同的布局（分别为基于父节点的布局和压缩稀疏行布局）表示同一个量。

Compute the composite rigid body inertia with mj_crb, add terms due to tendon armature. The joint-space inertia matrix is stored in both mjData.qM and mjData.M. These arrays represent the same quantity using different layouts (parent-based and compressed sparse row, respectively).

mj_factorM#

void mj_factorM(const mjModel* m, mjData* d);

计算惯性矩阵的稀疏 \(L^T D L\) 分解。

Compute sparse \(L^T D L\) factorizaton of inertia matrix.

mj_solveM#

void mj_solveM(const mjModel* m, mjData* d, mjtNum* x, const mjtNum* y, int n);

利用分解求解线性方程组 \(M x = y\)：\(x = (L^T D L)^{-1} y\)

Solve linear system \(M x = y\) using factorization: \(x = (L^T D L)^{-1} y\)

mj_solveM2#

void mj_solveM2(const mjModel* m, mjData* d, mjtNum* x, const mjtNum* y,
                const mjtNum* sqrtInvD, int n);

线性求解的一半：\(x = \sqrt{D^{-1}} (L^T)^{-1} y\)

Half of linear solve: \(x = \sqrt{D^{-1}} (L^T)^{-1} y\)

mj_comVel#

void mj_comVel(const mjModel* m, mjData* d);

计算 cvel、cdof_dot。

Compute cvel, cdof_dot.

mj_passive#

void mj_passive(const mjModel* m, mjData* d);

根据弹簧阻尼器、重力补偿（gravity compensation）和流体力计算 qfrc_passive。

Compute qfrc_passive from spring-dampers, gravity compensation and fluid forces.

mj_subtreeVel#

void mj_subtreeVel(const mjModel* m, mjData* d);

子树线速度和角动量：计算 subtree_linvel、subtree_angmom。如果模型中存在子树 速度 或 动量 传感器，则会自动触发该函数。对于 阶段 为 "vel" 的 用户传感器，也会触发该函数。

Sub-tree linear velocity and angular momentum: compute subtree_linvel, subtree_angmom. This function is triggered automatically if the subtree velocity or momentum sensors are present in the model. It is also triggered for user sensors of stage “vel”.

mj_rne#

void mj_rne(const mjModel* m, mjData* d, int flg_acc, mjtNum* result);

递归牛顿-欧拉算法：计算 \(M(q) \ddot q + C(q,\dot q)\)。flg_acc=0 会去掉惯性项（即假设 \(\ddot q = 0\)）。

Recursive Newton Euler: compute \(M(q) \ddot q + C(q,\dot q)\). flg_acc=0 removes the inertial term (i.e. assumes \(\ddot q = 0\)).

mj_rnePostConstraint#

void mj_rnePostConstraint(const mjModel* m, mjData* d);

使用最终计算出的力和加速度运行递归牛顿-欧拉算法。计算三个刚体级别的 nv x 6 数组，它们都定义在基于 subtreecom 的 c 坐标系 中，并按 [rotation(3), translation(3)] 的顺序排列。

Recursive Newton Euler with final computed forces and accelerations. Computes three body-level nv x 6 arrays, all defined in the subtreecom-based c-frame and arranged in [rotation(3), translation(3)] order.

  • cacc：刚体加速度，mj_objectAcceleration 需要它。

    cacc: Body acceleration, required for mj_objectAcceleration.

  • cfrc_int：与父刚体之间的相互作用力。

    cfrc_int: Interaction force with the parent body.

  • cfrc_ext：作用在刚体上的外力。

    cfrc_ext: External force acting on the body.

如果模型中存在以下传感器，则会自动触发该函数：加速度计、力、力矩、framelinacc、frameangacc。对于 阶段 为 "acc" 的 用户传感器，也会触发该函数。

This function is triggered automatically if the following sensors are present in the model: accelerometer, force, torque, framelinacc, frameangacc. It is also triggered for user sensors of stage “acc”.

cfrc_ext 汇集了不通过关节传递的力：外加的笛卡尔力（xfrc_applied）、接触、connect 和 weld 约束，以及空间肌腱（沿肌腱路径的弹簧力、阻尼力、执行器力、约束力和电枢惯量力）。cfrc_int 则是通过关节传递的力旋量（wrench），它在关节轴上的投影即为总的关节空间力。采用 site、曲柄滑块和 body 传动的执行器的力、重力补偿、流体力、flex 力以及自定义被动力目前尚未被汇集，而是被归入关节。

cfrc_ext collects the forces that are not transmitted through the joints: applied Cartesian forces (xfrc_applied), contacts, connect and weld constraints, and spatial tendons (spring, damper, actuator, constraint and armature forces along the tendon path). cfrc_int is then the wrench transmitted through the joint, and its projection on the joint axes is the total joint-space force. Forces of actuators with site, slider-crank and body transmissions, gravity compensation, fluid forces, flex forces and custom passive forces are not yet collected and are attributed to the joints.

mj_maxContact#

int mj_maxContact(const mjModel* m, int g1, int g2, int has_margin);

返回两个 geom 之间最多可以产生的接触数量。

Return the maximum number of contacts that can be generated between two geoms.

如果 has_margin 为 -1，则从模型中读取 margin；如果 has_margin > 0，则表示这些 geom 具有正的 margin。

If has_margin is -1, then the margin is pulled from the model, otherwise if has_margin > 0 indicates that the geoms have a positive margin.

mj_constraintUpdate#

void mj_constraintUpdate(const mjModel* m, mjData* d, const mjtNum* jar,
                         mjtNum cost[1], int flg_coneHessian);

计算 efc_state、efc_force、qfrc_constraint，以及（可选的）锥 Hessian。如果 cost 不是 NULL，则设置 *cost = s(jar)，其中 jar = Jac*qacc - aref。

可为 NULL： cost

光线投射#

Ray casting

光线碰撞（也称光线投射）用于求光线与 geom 交点的距离 x，其中光线是从 3D 点 p 出发、沿方向 v 的射线，即 (p + x*v, x >= 0)。该系列的所有函数都返回到最近 geom 表面的距离，如果没有交点则返回 -1。请注意，如果 p 位于某个 geom 内部，光线将从内部与表面相交，这仍然算作相交。

Ray collisions, also known as ray casting, find the distance x of a ray’s intersection with a geom, where a ray is a line emanating from the 3D point p in the direction v i.e., (p + x*v, x >= 0). All functions in this family return the distance to the nearest geom surface, or -1 if there is no intersection. Note that if p is inside a geom, the ray will intersect the surface from the inside which still counts as an intersection.

所有光线碰撞函数都依赖 mj_kinematics 计算出的量（参见 mjData），因此必须在 mj_kinematics 或调用它的函数（例如 mj_fwdPosition）之后调用。与所有 geom 类型求交的顶层函数有 mj_ray（投射单条光线）和 mj_multiRay（从单个点投射多条光线）。

All ray collision functions rely on quantities computed by mj_kinematics (see mjData), so must be called after mj_kinematics, or functions that call it (e.g. mj_fwdPosition). The top level functions, which intersect with all geoms types, are mj_ray which casts a single ray, and mj_multiRay which casts multiple rays from a single point.

mj_ray#

mjtNum mj_ray(const mjModel* m, const mjData* d, const mjtNum pnt[3], const mjtNum vec[3],
              const mjtByte* geomgroup, mjtBool flg_static, int bodyexclude,
              int geomid[1], mjtNum normal[3]);

求光线 pnt+x*vec, x >= 0 与 geom 的交点。

Intersect ray pnt+x*vec, x >= 0 with geoms.

  • 返回到最近表面的距离 x，如果没有交点则返回 -1。

    Return distance x to nearest surface, or -1 if no intersection.

  • 如果 geomid 不为 NULL，则写入相交 geom 的 id，没有交点时写入 -1。

    If geomid is not NULL, write the id of the intersected geom or -1 if not intersection.

  • 如果 normal 不为 NULL，则写入交点处的表面法向量。无论光线方向如何（包括从内部击中表面的光线），法向量始终 指向几何体外部。

    If normal is not NULL, write the surface normal at the intersection point. The normal always points out of the geometry, regardless of the ray’s direction (i.e., including rays hitting the surface from the inside).

  • 排除 id 为 bodyexclude 的刚体中的 geom，使用 -1 表示包含所有刚体。

    Exclude geoms in body with id bodyexclude, use -1 to include all bodies.

  • geomgroup 是长度为 mjNGROUP 的数组，其中 1 表示应包含该组。传入 NULL 则跳过 geom 组的排除。

    geomgroup is an array of length mjNGROUP, where 1 means the group should be included. Pass NULL to skip geom group exclusion.

  • 如果 flg_static 为 0，则静态 geom 将被排除。

    If flg_static is 0, static geoms will be excluded.

可为 NULL： geomgroup, geomid, normal

虚拟文件系统#

Virtual file system

虚拟文件系统（VFS）使用户能够把所有必需的文件加载到内存中，包括 MJB 二进制模型文件、XML 文件（MJCF、URDF 以及被包含的文件）、STL 网格、用于纹理和高度场的 PNG，以及我们自定义高度场格式的 HF 文件。VFS 中的模型和资源文件也可以通过编程方式构造（例如使用写入内存的 Python 库）。当所有需要的文件都放入 VFS 之后，用户就可以带着指向 VFS 的指针调用 mj_loadModel 或 mj_loadXML。当该指针不为 NULL 时，加载器会先在 VFS 中查找将要加载的文件，只有在 VFS 中找不到该文件时才会访问磁盘。

Virtual file system (VFS) enables the user to load all necessary files in memory, including MJB binary model files, XML files (MJCF, URDF and included files), STL meshes, PNGs for textures and height fields, and HF files in our custom height field format. Model and resource files in the VFS can also be constructed programmatically (say using a Python library that writes to memory). Once all desired files are in the VFS, the user can call mj_loadModel or mj_loadXML with a pointer to the VFS. When this pointer is not NULL, the loaders will first check the VFS for any files they are about to load, and only access the disk if the file is not found in the VFS.

VFS 必须先用 mj_defaultVFS 分配，并且必须用 mj_deleteVFS 释放。

The VFS must first be allocated using mj_defaultVFS and must be freed with mj_deleteVFS.

mj_defaultVFS#

void mj_defaultVFS(mjVFS* vfs);

初始化一个空的 VFS，必须调用 mj_deleteVFS 来释放该 VFS。

Initialize an empty VFS, mj_deleteVFS must be called to deallocate the VFS.

Mount a provider to handle file operations under the given path; return 0: success, 2: repeated name, -1: invalid provider.

将文件添加到 VFS。directory 参数是可选的，可以为 NULL 或空。成功时返回 0，名称冲突时返回 2，发生内部错误时返回 -1。

Add file to VFS. The directory argument is optional and can be NULL or empty. Returns 0 on success, 2 on name collision, or -1 when an internal error occurs.

Add file to VFS from buffer; return 0: success, 2: repeated name, -1: failed to load.

资源缓存#

Asset cache

资源缓存是一种缓存资源（例如纹理、网格等）的机制，用于避免重复进行缓慢的重新编译。下列方法提供了控制缓存容量或将其完全禁用的途径。

The asset cache is a mechanism for caching assets (e.g. textures, meshes, etc.) to avoid repeated slow recompilation. The following methods provide way to control the capacity of the cache or to disable it altogether.

mj_getCacheSize#

size_t mj_getCacheSize(const mjCache* cache);

获取资源缓存当前的大小（以字节为单位）。

Get the current size of the asset cache in bytes.

mj_getCacheCapacity#

size_t mj_getCacheCapacity(const mjCache* cache);

获取资源缓存的容量（以字节为单位）。

Get the capacity of the asset cache in bytes.

mj_setCacheCapacity#

size_t mj_setCacheCapacity(mjCache* cache, size_t size);

设置资源缓存的容量（以字节为单位，0 表示禁用）；返回新的容量。

Set the capacity of the asset cache in bytes (0 to disable); return the new capacity.

mj_getCache#

mjCache* mj_getCache(void);

获取编译器使用的内部资源缓存。

Get the internal asset cache used by the compiler.

mj_clearCache#

void mj_clearCache(mjCache* cache);

清空资源缓存。

Clear the asset cache.

Resources are the interface between resource providers and MuJoCo model compilation code. These functions provide the means to query the resource provider and obtain resources.

若时间戳一致则返回 0，资源较新则返回 >0，资源较旧则返回 <0。

Return 0 if timestamps match, >0 if resource is newer, <0 if resource is older.

mj_saveModel#

将模型保存为二进制 MJB 文件或内存缓冲区；若同时给出，则缓冲区优先。模型按原样写入：含有 按引用 纹理的模型会将它们保留为引用，该文件在路径可解析的任何位置都能加载。要得到自包含（hermetic）的文件，应依次调用 mj_embedAssets，对其结果调用 mj_saveModel，最后调用 mj_deleteModel。

The model is written as it is: a model with by-reference textures keeps them as references, and the file loads wherever the paths resolve. 错误与内存#

Error and memory

mju_error#

void mju_error(const char* msg, ...) mjPRINTFLIKE(1, 2);

主错误函数。错误消息会分发给当前活动的日志处理器，参见 mju_setLogHandler。错误始终是致命的：若处理器返回，进程将以 exit(EXIT_FAILURE) 终止。希望恢复的处理器必须在返回之前使用 longjmp 或以其他方式转移控制流。

Main error function. The error message is dispatched to the active log handler (see mju_setLogHandler). Errors are always fatal: if the handler returns, the process is terminated with exit(EXIT_FAILURE). Handlers wishing to recover must longjmp or otherwise transfer control before returning.

mju_warning#

void mju_warning(const char* msg, ...) mjPRINTFLIKE(1, 2);

主警告函数；会返回给调用者。警告消息会分发给当前活动的日志处理器。

Main warning function; returns to caller. The warning message is dispatched to the active log handler.

mju_clearHandlers#

void mju_clearHandlers(void);

清除所有用户处理器并恢复默认值。将旧版的错误/警告/内存回调重置为 NULL ，恢复默认日志处理器，并将日志配置重置为默认值（启用控制台和文件输出，禁用所有 info 主题）。

Clear all user handlers and restore defaults. Resets the legacy error/warning/memory callbacks to NULL, restores the default log handler, and resets the log configuration to its defaults (console and file output enabled, all info topics disabled).

mju_setLogHandler#

mjfLogHandler mju_setLogHandler(mjfLogHandler handler);

设置当前活动的全局日志处理器。返回先前的处理器（永远不为 NULL ），用于保存/恢复或回调链接。若 handler 为 NULL ，则恢复默认处理器。处理器会以结构化的 mjLogMessage 形式接收所有错误、警告和信息性消息。用法示例参见 安装处理器。

Set the active global log handler. Returns the previous handler (which is never NULL), intended for save/restore or callback chaining. If handler is NULL, the default handler is restored. The handler receives all errors, warnings and informational messages as a structured mjLogMessage. See Installing a handler for usage examples.

mju_getLogConfig#

mjLogConfig mju_getLogConfig(void);

获取当前默认处理器的配置。参见 mjLogConfig。

Get the current default handler configuration. See mjLogConfig.

mju_setLogConfig#

void mju_setLogConfig(mjLogConfig config);

设置默认处理器的配置。控制控制台输出、文件输出和 info 主题过滤。参见 mjLogConfig。

Set the default handler configuration. Controls console output, file output, and info topic filtering. See mjLogConfig.

示例用法（禁用文件输出）：

Example usage (disabling file output):
mjLogConfig config = mju_getLogConfig();
config.logto_file = false;
mju_setLogConfig(config);

mju_info#

void mju_info(int topic, const char* msg, ...) mjPRINTFLIKE(2, 3);

记录一条信息性消息，可选地进行主题过滤。 topic 参数是一个 mjtLogTopic 值。主题 0（ mjTOPIC_NONE ）始终通过。其他主题必须通过 mju_setLogConfig 在默认处理器配置中启用。注意，主题过滤是在默认处理器中实现的；自定义处理器无论如何都会收到所有 info 消息。

Log an informational message with optional topic filtering. The topic argument is a mjtLogTopic value. Topic 0 (mjTOPIC_NONE) always passes through. Other topics must be enabled in the default handler configuration via mju_setLogConfig. Note that topic filtering is implemented in the default handler; custom handlers receive all info messages regardless.

mju_message#

void mju_message(const mjLogMessage* msg);

将结构化的 mjLogMessage 分发给当前活动的日志处理器。这是发出日志消息的主要入口，可完全控制所有字段。便捷函数 mju_error、mju_warning 和 mju_info 只是对本函数的薄封装，它们填充一个 mjLogMessage 并调用本函数。

Dispatch a structured mjLogMessage to the active log handler. This is the primary entry point for emitting log messages with full control over all fields. The convenience functions mju_error, mju_warning, and mju_info are thin wrappers that populate an mjLogMessage and call this function.

subject 字段是一行摘要（最多 1024 字节，内联于结构体中）。 body 字段是指向多行详细文本的可选 const char* 指针，由调用者持有。当 body 为 NULL 时，只打印摘要行。

The subject field is a one-line summary (up to 1024 bytes, inline in the struct). The body field is an optional const char* pointer to multi-line detail text, owned by the caller. When body is NULL, only the subject line is printed.

默认处理器按如下方式格式化输出：

The default handler formats the output as follows:
LEVEL FUNC (FILE:LINE) TIME: SUBJECT
BODY

其中：

where:

  • LEVEL 为 ERROR, WARNING, INFO 或 DEBUG。

    LEVEL is ERROR, WARNING, INFO, or DEBUG.

  • 设置了 func 字段时才有 FUNC。

    FUNC is present when the func field is set.

  • 设置了 file 和 line 字段时才有 (FILE:LINE)。

    (FILE:LINE) is present when the file and line fields are set.

  • 设置了 timestamp 字段或启用了文件日志时才有 TIME。

    TIME is present when the timestamp field is set or file logging is active.

  • SUBJECT 是 subject 字段的内容。

    SUBJECT is the contents of the subject field.

  • BODY 位于后续行，原样打印，不加缩进或分隔符，且仅当其非 NULL 时才有。

    BODY follows on the next line(s), printed raw without indentation or separators, only if non-NULL.

默认处理器会在 ERROR, WARNING 和 INFO 消息之后追加一个空行，以便在视觉上分隔。 DEBUG 消息紧凑打印，后面没有空行。

The default handler appends a trailing blank line after ERROR, WARNING, and INFO messages for visual separation. DEBUG messages are printed compactly without a trailing blank line.

示例用法：

Example usage:
mjLogMessage msg = {
  .level = mjLOG_INFO,
  .timestamp = true,
  .body = "  height:     0.001 m\n  velocity:   0.000 m/s\n  bounces:    47",
};
snprintf(msg.subject, sizeof(msg.subject), "The ball has come to rest");
mju_message(&msg);

输出如下：

This produces:
INFO Mon Jun  9 15:04:05 2026: The ball has come to rest
  height:     0.001 m
  velocity:   0.000 m/s
  bounces:    47

mjv_select#

int mjv_select(const mjModel* m, const mjData* d, const mjvOption* vopt,
               mjtNum aspectratio, mjtNum relx, mjtNum rely,
               const mjvScene* scn, mjtNum selpnt[3],
               int geomid[1], int flexid[1], int skinid[1]);

此函数用于鼠标选取，依赖射线相交。aspectratio 是视口的宽/高。relx 和 rely 是感兴趣的二维点（通常是鼠标光标）在视口中的相对坐标。函数返回指定二维点下方 geom 的 id，若没有 geom 则返回 -1（注意，天空盒（若存在）不是模型的 geom）。被点击点的三维坐标通过 selpnt 返回。示例参见 simulate。

This function is used for mouse selection, relying on ray intersections. aspectratio is the viewport width/height. relx and rely are the relative coordinates of the 2D point of interest in the viewport (usually mouse cursor). The function returns the id of the geom under the specified 2D point, or -1 if there is no geom (note that they skybox if present is not a model geom). The 3D coordinates of the clicked point are returned in selpnt. See simulate for an illustration.

可视化#

Visualization

本节中的函数实现抽象可视化。其结果供 OpenGL 渲染器使用，也可供希望实现自己的渲染器、或将 MuJoCo 接入 Unity 或 Unreal Engine 等高级渲染工具的用户使用。关于如何使用这些函数，参见 simulate。

The functions in this section implement abstract visualization. The results are used by the OpenGL renderer, and can also be used by users wishing to implement their own renderer, or hook up MuJoCo to advanced rendering tools such as Unity or Unreal Engine. See simulate for illustration of how to use these functions.

mjrf_render#

mjrfFrameHandle mjrf_render(mjrfContext* ctx, const mjrfRenderRequest* req, int nreq,
                      const mjrfReadRequest* read_req, int nread_req);

提交给定的渲染请求。由于渲染是异步进行的，调用者必须在同一次调用中同时提交渲染请求和读取请求。单次调用中可以提交多个请求和读取。这些请求将按顺序处理，因此需要多加注意。首先，请求应按目标分组。其次，针对同一目标的所有请求的视口合并面积必须包含在该目标自身的尺寸之内。

Submits the given requests for rendering. Because rendering happens asynchronously, callers have to submit both the render and read requests in the same call. Multiple requests and reads can be submitted in a single call. These requests will be processed in order, so some care must be taken. Firstly, requests should be grouped by target. Next, the combined area of the viewports for all requests for a given target must be contained within the dimensions of the target itself.

回调将在此函数内部被调用，但不保证是在此函数的哪一次调用中完成。

Callbacks will be invoked from within this function, though there is no guarantee on which invocation of this function it will be done.

void mjrf_waitForFrame(mjrfContext* ctx, mjrfFrameHandle frame);

等待给定帧句柄的所有渲染操作完成，并按需触发所有回调。

Waits for all rendering operations to complete for the given frame handle, triggering any callbacks as needed.

将待处理的操作刷新到渲染后端，并调用所有已完成的回调。

Flushes pending operations to the rendering backend and invokes any completed callbacks.

设置该可渲染对象的大小。请注意，对于大多数可渲染对象，这等价于设置缩放。但是，对于某些基于 geom 的可渲染对象，大小缩放并不是均匀施加的（例如，胶囊体的球形端部会按比例缩放，以使其始终保持球形）。

Sets the size of the renderable. Note that, for most renderables, this is equivalent to setting the scale. However, for some geom-based renderables, the size scale is not applied uniformly (e.g. the spherical ends of a capsule are scaled such that they always remain spherical).

UI 框架#

UI framework

关于 UI 框架的高层描述，参见 用户界面。

For a high-level description of the UI framework, see User Interface.

mjui_themeSpacing#

mjuiThemeSpacing mjui_themeSpacing(int ind);

获取内置的 UI 主题间距（ind：0-1）。

Get builtin UI theme spacing (ind: 0-1).

mjui_themeColor#

mjuiThemeColor mjui_themeColor(int ind);

获取内置的 UI 主题颜色（ind：0-3）。

Get builtin UI theme color (ind: 0-3).

mjui_add#

void mjui_add(mjUI* ui, const mjuiDef* def);

这是用于构建 UI 的辅助函数。第二个参数指向一个 mjuiDef 结构体数组，其中每个结构体对应一个项。最后一个（未使用的）项的类型被设为 -1，用以标记结束。这些项会被添加到最后一个已使用分区的末尾之后。此函数还有另一个版本（mjui_addToSection），它将项添加到指定的分区，而不是添加到 UI 的末尾。请记住，预分配的分区数量和每个分区的项数量都有上限，分别由 mjMAXUISECT 和 mjMAXUIITEM 给出。超过这些上限会导致底层错误。

This is the helper function used to construct a UI. The second argument points to an array of mjuiDef structs, each corresponding to one item. The last (unused) item has its type set to -1, to mark termination. The items are added after the end of the last used section. There is also another version of this function (mjui_addToSection) which adds items to a specified section instead of adding them at the end of the UI. Keep in mind that there is a maximum preallocated number of sections and items per section, given by mjMAXUISECT and mjMAXUIITEM. Exceeding these maxima results in low-level errors.

mjui_addToSection#

void mjui_addToSection(mjUI* ui, int sect, const mjuiDef* def);

向 UI 分区添加定义。

Add definitions to UI section.

mjui_resize#

void mjui_resize(mjUI* ui, const mjrContext* con);

计算 UI 的尺寸。

Compute UI sizes.

mjui_update#

void mjui_update(int section, int item, const mjUI* ui,
                 const mjuiState* state, const mjrContext* con);

这是主要的 UI 更新函数。每当用户数据（由各项的数据指针所指向）发生变化，或 UI 状态本身发生变化时，都需要调用它。它通常由用户实现的更高层函数调用（simulate.cc 中的 UiModify），该高层函数还会重新计算所有矩形及相关辅助缓冲区的布局。此函数会更新离屏 OpenGL 缓冲区中的像素。为了执行最小化更新，用户需要指定被修改的分区（section）和项（item）。值为 -1 表示所有项和/或分区都需要更新（在发生重大变化之后需要这样做。）

This is the main UI update function. It needs to be called whenever the user data (pointed to by the item data pointers) changes, or when the UI state itself changes. It is normally called by a higher-level function implemented by the user (UiModify in simulate.cc) which also recomputes the layout of all rectangles and associated auxiliary buffers. The function updates the pixels in the offscreen OpenGL buffer. To perform minimal updates, the user specifies the section and the item that was modified. A value of -1 means all items and/or sections need to be updated (which is needed following major changes.)

mjui_event#

mjuiItem* mjui_event(mjUI* ui, mjuiState* state, const mjrContext* con);

此函数是底层事件处理器。它会在 UI 中做出必要的更改，并返回一个指向接收该事件的项的指针（如果没有记录到有效事件，则返回 NULL）。它通常在用户实现的事件处理器（simulate.cc 中的 UiEvent）内部调用，随后用户代码会根据被修改的 UI 项以及该项在事件处理后的状态来采取相应的操作。

This function is the low-level event handler. It makes the necessary changes in the UI and returns a pointer to the item that received the event (or NULL if no valid event was recorded). This is normally called within the event handler implemented by the user (UiEvent in simulate.cc), and then some action is taken by user code depending on which UI item was modified and what the state of that item is after the event is handled.

mjui_render#

void mjui_render(mjUI* ui, const mjuiState* state, const mjrContext* con);

此函数在屏幕刷新循环中调用。它将离屏 OpenGL 缓冲区复制到窗口帧缓冲区。如果应用程序中有多个 UI，则应对每个 UI 各调用一次。因此，mjui_render 会一直被调用，而 mjui_update 仅在 UI 发生变化时才被调用。dsffsdg

This function is called in the screen refresh loop. It copies the offscreen OpenGL buffer to the window framebuffer. If there are multiple UIs in the application, it should be called once for each UI. Thus mjui_render is called all the time, while mjui_update is called only when changes in the UI take place. dsffsdg

导数#

Derivatives

下面的函数提供了各种函数的有用导数，既有解析形式的，也有有限差分形式的。后者的名称带有后缀 FD。请注意，与 API 的大部分函数不同，导数函数的输出位于参数列表的末尾而非开头。

The functions below provide useful derivatives of various functions, both analytic and finite-differenced. The latter have names with the suffix FD. Note that unlike much of the API, outputs of derivative functions are the trailing rather than leading arguments.

mjd_transitionFD#

void mjd_transitionFD(const mjModel* m, mjData* d, mjtNum eps, mjtBool flg_centered,
                      mjtNum* A, mjtNum* B, mjtNum* C, mjtNum* D);

计算有限差分形式的离散时间状态转移矩阵。

Compute finite-differenced discrete-time transition matrices.

设 \(x, u\) 表示 mjData 实例中当前的 状态 和 控制 向量，设 \(y, s\) 表示下一时刻的状态和传感器（sensor）值，则顶层函数 mj_step 计算 \((x,u) \rightarrow (y,s)\)。mjd_transitionFD 使用有限差分计算相关的四个雅可比矩阵（Jacobian）。这些矩阵及其维度如下：

Letting \(x, u\) denote the current state and control vector in an mjData instance, and letting \(y, s\) denote the next state and sensor values, the top-level mj_step function computes \((x,u) \rightarrow (y,s)\) mjd_transitionFD computes the four associated Jacobians using finite-differencing. These matrices and their dimensions are:

矩阵

matrix

雅可比

Jacobian

维度

dimension

A

\(\partial y / \partial x\)

2*nv+na x 2*nv+na

B

\(\partial y / \partial u\)

2*nv+na x nu

C

\(\partial s / \partial x\)

nsensordata x 2*nv+na

D

\(\partial s / \partial u\)

nsensordata x nu

  • 所有输出都是可选的（可以为 NULL）。

    All outputs are optional (can be NULL).

  • eps 是有限差分的 epsilon。

    eps is the finite-differencing epsilon.

  • flg_centered 表示使用前向差分（0）还是中心差分（1）。

    flg_centered denotes whether to use forward (0) or centered (1) differences.

  • 不支持龙格-库塔积分器（integrator）（mjINT_RK4）。

    The Runge-Kutta integrator (mjINT_RK4) is not supported.

  • 不支持 休眠。调用前请禁用 sleep 标志。

    Sleeping is not supported. Disable the sleep flag before calling.

  • 不支持 延迟。

    Delays are not supported.

提升速度和精度

Improving speed and accuracy
热启动
warmstart

如果没有 禁用 热启动（warm start），则调用时已存在的热启动加速度 mjData.qacc_warmstart 会在每次相关流水线调用开始时被载入，以保证确定性。如果求解器（solver）的计算在仿真中开销较大，则下面的技巧可以带来显著的加速：首先调用 mj_forward 让求解器收敛，然后大幅减少 求解器迭代次数，接着调用 mjd_transitionFD，最后恢复 iterations 的原始值。由于我们已经接近解，只需很少的迭代就能找到新的极小值。对于 Newton 求解器尤其如此，其在极小值附近收敛所需的迭代次数可低至 1。

If warm-starts are not disabled, the warm-start accelerations mjData.qacc_warmstart which are present at call-time are loaded at the start of every relevant pipeline call, to preserve determinism. If solver computations are an expensive part of the simulation, the following trick can lead to significant speed-ups: First call mj_forward to let the solver converge, then reduce solver iterations significantly, then call mjd_transitionFD, finally, restore the original value of iterations. Because we are already near the solution, few iteration are required to find the new minimum. This is especially true for the Newton solver, where the required number of iteration for convergence near the minimum can be as low as 1.
容差
tolerance

如果将求解器 容差 设为 0，则可以提高精度。这意味着对求解器的所有调用都会执行完全相同的迭代次数，从而避免因提前终止而产生的数值误差。当然，这也意味着 求解器迭代次数 应当较小，以免在极小值处原地空转。此方法与上述方法可以也应当结合使用。

Accuracy can be improved if solver tolerance is set to 0. This means that all calls to the solver will perform exactly the same number of iterations, preventing numerical errors due to early termination. Of course, this means that solver iterations should be small, to not tread water at the minimum. This method and the one described above can and should be combined.

可为空： A, B, D, C

Nullable: A, B, D, C

mjd_inverseFD#

void mjd_inverseFD(const mjModel* m, mjData* d, mjtNum eps, mjtBool flg_actuation,
                   mjtNum *DfDq, mjtNum *DfDv, mjtNum *DfDa,
                   mjtNum *DsDq, mjtNum *DsDv, mjtNum *DsDa,
                   mjtNum *DmDq);

有限差分形式的连续时间逆动力学雅可比矩阵。

Finite differenced continuous-time inverse-dynamics Jacobians.

设 \(x, a\) 表示 mjData 实例中当前的 状态 和加速度向量，设 \(f, s\) 表示由逆动力学计算出的力（qfrc_inverse），则函数 mj_inverse 计算 \((x,a) \rightarrow (f,s)\)。mjd_inverseFD 使用有限差分计算相关的七个雅可比矩阵。这些矩阵及其维度如下：

Letting \(x, a\) denote the current state and acceleration vectors in an mjData instance, and letting \(f, s\) denote the forces computed by the inverse dynamics (qfrc_inverse), the function mj_inverse computes \((x,a) \rightarrow (f,s)\). mjd_inverseFD computes seven associated Jacobians using finite-differencing. These matrices and their dimensions are:

矩阵

matrix

雅可比

Jacobian

维度

dimension

DfDq

\(\partial f / \partial q\)

nv x nv

DfDv

\(\partial f / \partial v\)

nv x nv

DfDa

\(\partial f / \partial a\)

nv x nv

DsDq

\(\partial s / \partial q\)

nv x nsensordata

DsDv

\(\partial s / \partial v\)

nv x nsensordata

DsDa

\(\partial s / \partial a\)

nv x nsensordata

DmDq

\(\partial M / \partial q\)

nv x nC

  • 所有输出都是可选的（可以为 NULL）。

    All outputs are optional (can be NULL).

  • 所有输出相对于控制理论的惯例都是转置的（即列主序）。

    All outputs are transposed relative to Control Theory convention (i.e., column major).

  • DmDq 包含 nv x nv x nv 张量 \(\partial M / \partial q\) 的稀疏表示，严格来说它并不是逆动力学雅可比，但在相关应用中很有用。提供它是为了方便用户，因为只要请求了另外两个 \(\partial / \partial q\) 雅可比中的任意一个，所需的值就已经被计算出来了。

    DmDq, which contains a sparse representation of the nv x nv x nv tensor \(\partial M / \partial q\), is not strictly an inverse dynamics Jacobian but is useful in related applications. It is provided as a convenience to the user, since the required values are already computed if either of the other two \(\partial / \partial q\) Jacobians are requested.

  • eps 是（前向）有限差分的 epsilon。

    eps is the (forward) finite-differencing epsilon.

  • flg_actuation 表示是否从逆动力学的输出中减去执行器（actuator）力（qfrc_actuator）。如果该标志为正，则执行器力不被视为外力。

    flg_actuation denotes whether to subtract actuation forces (qfrc_actuator) from the output of the inverse dynamics. If this flag is positive, actuator forces are not considered as external.

  • 模型选项标志 invdiscrete 应与 mjData.qacc 的表示方式相对应，才能计算出正确的导数信息。

    The model option flag invdiscrete should correspond to the representation of mjData.qacc in order to compute the correct derivative information.

注意

Attention

  • 不支持四阶龙格-库塔积分器（mjINT_RK4）。

    The Runge-Kutta 4th-order integrator (mjINT_RK4) is not supported.

  • 不支持 noslip 求解器。

    The noslip solver is not supported.

  • 不支持 休眠。调用前请禁用 sleep 标志。

    Sleeping is not supported. Disable the sleep flag before calling.

可为空： DfDq, DfDv, DfDa, DsDq, DsDv, DsDa, DmDq

Nullable: DfDq, DfDv, DfDa, DsDq, DsDv, DsDa, DmDq

mjd_subQuat#

void mjd_subQuat(const mjtNum qa[4], const mjtNum qb[4], mjtNum Da[9], mjtNum Db[9]);

mju_subQuat（四元数（quaternion）之差）的导数。

Derivatives of mju_subQuat (quaternion difference).

可为空： Da, Db

Nullable: Da, Db

mjd_quatIntegrate#

void mjd_quatIntegrate(const mjtNum vel[3], mjtNum scale,
                       mjtNum Dquat[9], mjtNum Dvel[9], mjtNum Dscale[3]);

mju_quatIntegrate 的导数。

Derivatives of mju_quatIntegrate.

\({\tt \small mju\_quatIntegrate}(q, v, h)\) 执行原地旋转 \(q \leftarrow q + v h\)，其中 \(q \in \mathbf{S}^3\) 是单位四元数，\(v \in \mathbf{R}^3\) 是三维角速度，\(h \in \mathbf{R^+}\) 是时间步长（timestep）。这等价于 \({\tt \small mju\_quatIntegrate}(q, s, 1.0)\)，其中 \(s\) 是缩放后的速度 \(s = h v\)。

\({\tt \small mju\_quatIntegrate}(q, v, h)\) performs the in-place rotation \(q \leftarrow q + v h\), where \(q \in \mathbf{S}^3\) is a unit quaternion, \(v \in \mathbf{R}^3\) is a 3D angular velocity and \(h \in \mathbf{R^+}\) is a timestep. This is equivalent to \({\tt \small mju\_quatIntegrate}(q, s, 1.0)\), where \(s\) is the scaled velocity \(s = h v\).

\({\tt \small mjd\_quatIntegrate}(v, h, D_q, D_v, D_h)\) 计算输出 \(q\) 关于各输入的雅可比矩阵。下面用 \(\bar q\) 表示修改前的四元数：

\({\tt \small mjd\_quatIntegrate}(v, h, D_q, D_v, D_h)\) computes the Jacobians of the output \(q\) with respect to the inputs. Below, \(\bar q\) denotes the pre-modified quaternion:
\[\begin{aligned} D_q &= \partial q / \partial \bar q \\ D_v &= \partial q / \partial v \\ D_h &= \partial q / \partial h \end{aligned} \]

请注意，导数仅取决于 \(h\) 和 \(v\)（实际上取决于 \(s = h v\)）。所有输出都是可选的。

Note that derivatives depend only on \(h\) and \(v\) (in fact, on \(s = h v\)). All outputs are optional.

可为空： Dquat, Dvel, Dscale

Nullable: Dquat, Dvel, Dscale
